Please refer to clinical data for this case for details on when post-treatment samples were taken.

Because the value for field 'Metastatic status at diagnosis' in the original data is 'Non-metastatic (confirmed)', the GDC value for 'Metastatic site(s) at diagnosis' has been modified from 'Lung only' to NULL. The value in the Supplement File is unchanged.

Ten cases were moved from TARGET-ALL-P2 to TARGET-ALL-P1 at the request of the Office of Cancer Genomics (OCG). These cases are a part of the TARGET-ALL-P1 study but since the related aliquots underwent sequencing at the same time as a TARGET-ALL-P2 set, these cases had previously been inadvertently grouped with that project. Please note that these cases and some associated data will still appear in TARGET-ALL-P2 in the GDC Legacy Archive. For additional information, please contact ocg@mail.nih.gov.
